head: 05870870931211335434b22d5f8818d6e088faa2
claim: A stuck worker's question dialog is recorded by the watcher and climbs owner, Main and a board card, then clears when answered

steps.start: a real Claude Haiku worker pane with no question open
steps: the worker opens an AskUserQuestion dialog
the watcher records the dialog as a question wait source
steps.result: the wait source and episode are cleared after the dialog is answered

verdicts.seen: Read all 13 lines. The replay shows 'wait source: question' (part 0), 'owner rung fired' (1), 'Main rung fired' (2), 'board card raised: 1 raise call(s)' (3), and 'dialog answered; wait source cleared' followed by PASS (4). It shows every stage the outcome names, in order.

Read all 22 lines of the pane. It shows the live 'Which color?' question dialog with 'Enter to select · ↑/↓ to navigate · Esc to cancel', which is the dialog stage. It does not show the watcher recording, any escalation, or the card.

Read all lines. The pane shows '● User answered Claude's questions: · Which color? → Red', with the dialog gone. That is the answered and cleared stage. It does not show the watcher or escalation stages.

Read all 5 entries. Entry 2 shows 'waiting-state w1 (question, observed 2s, level=owner ...)' and entry 3 shows 'observed 23s, level=main'. Both use source [question: Enter to select ...], so the watcher recorded the dialog and it climbed owner then Main. The 'stale: lab:w' lines do not contradict this. No board or clearing entry here.

Read both lines. The first is a 'raise' call with --ask-ref waiting-w1, the card key, and title 'Unblock stuck work?', showing the board card raised for w1. The second dismisses that card. This covers the card stage only.
